FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: Check out our FAQs on the best Web Development Course about course features, fees, scholarships, and much more.

FaqDATA.ques: Who is Skillslash? What do they do?
FaqDATA.ans: Skillslash is an ed-tech company that offers career-focused programmes for coders and professionals across domains including Full Stack Web Development, Data Science, Business Analytics, and Blockchain. We encourage our learners to build high-level certification through real, industry-based work experience, and our curriculum is designed around what companies are actually hiring for, at course fees that stay affordable.

FaqDATA.ques: How will I benefit from industry mentors?
FaqDATA.ans: Our industry mentors have worked at prestigious companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, and they bring that experience directly into code reviews and technical feedback. Through the training you'll get the chance to work with companies on live projects, and our mentors help you prepare for MNC interviews with the kind of guided practice that's hard to get on your own. The syllabus is built to let you gain professional-level knowledge through practical, hands-on learning rather than theory alone.

FaqDATA.ques: Is any academic degree necessary to apply for a Web Development Course?
FaqDATA.ans: No academic degree is required. The course is built for professionals and recent graduates, and freshers with fundamental coding skills can also apply. The eligibility criteria come down to roughly 1 year of work experience for professionals, though holding a relevant academic degree is an advantage. Course fees start at INR 95,000 excluding GST, and the programme runs for around 11 months, with scholarship concessions available.

FaqDATA.ques: What does Skillslash's Web Development Course provide?
FaqDATA.ans: The course provides real work experience through both live online classes and a hybrid learning track, and you'll work directly on the industrial coding projects that partner firms are offering. It covers all the core concepts at fees starting at INR 95,000 without GST, and scholarships or concessions are available depending on your scholarship test score - reach out to our consultants for the specifics.

FaqDATA.ques: When can I start the course? What if I miss any of the sessions in the Full Stack Web Development online course?
FaqDATA.ans: You can start whenever the next cohort opens up. Classes are always recorded, so you can catch up on your own schedule if you miss a session, and you won't lose continuity - you simply join the next live session. There's no extra fee for this beyond the course fee already stated in the program features.

FaqDATA.ques: What kind of certification does Skillslash’s Full Stack Web Development training provide?
FaqDATA.ans: You don't just get an academic-style certificate - we issue globally recognized project certifications, and if you work on live projects with partner companies, they can issue you direct certification for that work as well. The syllabus is kept aligned with the skills companies are actually hiring for, so the certification reflects real, current capability.

Scholarships are based on a qualifying test - candidates who score at least 65% become eligible for a 10% discount on course fees. We also offer scholarships to unemployed candidates and to mothers returning to the workforce after a career break. Speak with our academic counsellor to learn more about the terms and conditions.

FaqDATA.ques: How many mock interviews and job referrals will I have throughout the Web Development training?
FaqDATA.ans: We offer unlimited job referrals and mentor support aimed at getting you placed at a product-based firm. As many mock interviews as you need are available until you're confident presenting your projects and experience, and instructors review your performance to focus on specific areas of weakness. Mentors and counsellors are available for guidance throughout the course.

FaqDATA.ques: Which role will I be eligible for after completing a Web Development course online?
FaqDATA.ans: You'll graduate with a portfolio built around what the industry actually needs, and can expect to be considered for roles such as Web Developer, Front End Developer, Back End Developer, and SDE. Mentor guidance throughout the course is aimed at helping you crack interviews at larger MNCs.

FaqDATA.ques: How will the doubts get resolved?
FaqDATA.ans: Since the course runs on weekend cohorts, we hold a dedicated doubt-clearing session every Wednesday in addition to regular class hours. Over 250 problem-solving challenges help reinforce your understanding, and small batch sizes make it easy for instructors to review your performance individually - so if you're stuck on a piece of Java code, for example, a mentor is there to help.

FaqDATA.ques: What is the program duration for a Web Development online course?
FaqDATA.ans: The programme runs for about 11 months, giving you enough time to build a solid grasp of the concepts and prepare for interviews at companies like MAANG. Experienced tutors guide you throughout, from the fundamentals to a more advanced level.

FaqDATA.ques: Is EMI payment acceptable in this Web Development institute?
FaqDATA.ans: Yes - EMI is available with terms and conditions applied, with no interest across the payment period. Payments can be spread over up to 12 months, and the amount can be customized to fit your budget.

FaqDATA.ques: How will the classes be conducted? What are the course timings for Web Development course?
FaqDATA.ans: All classes are conducted live through online learning platforms by experienced mentors, and every session is recorded for later reference. The course runs about 11 months in total to cover the full curriculum, and timings depend on cohort availability - most cohorts run on weekends.

FaqDATA.ques: What is the refund policy for the Web Development course?
FaqDATA.ans: Refund requests are accepted up to 15 days from the start of the course. If you haven't attended and want a refund, your request will be considered accordingly.
